nfc_cable_clearance.tail_continuous_bounds_method: The cubic Bezier lies inside its control-point convex hull; control x spans the full width interval, and the 2 mm bundle radius expands that hull. The R5 semicircle and straight ends have fixed bounds. The checked boxes enclose those bounds.
nfc_cable_clearance.tail_model: Nominal routing and a conservative free-space envelope; no constant-length flex simulation or cable spring-force measurement. Dress slack within this space and re-zero/check at every adjustment.
nfc_cable_clearance.maintenance: Two M2.5x10 prototype cover screws; one cover exposes rear cassette and lower side gutter. Tie slots at moving cover, guide leg and fixed-base saddle.
nfc_cable_clearance.concealment: Upper route behind guide/pod and removable cover; lower chute overlaps the open carrier bay without touching fixed lid. The flexible tail remains below the lid inside the base.
